verdict.rationale: Render documents ephemeral previews of the entire application architecture for every change, environment isolation that stops non-production environments from reaching production services, and short-lived instances for running one-off commands without connecting to production. Together these give an agent or user a sandbox for testing without touching production. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how preview environments handle data (e.g., separate or seeded preview databases), explicit agent-driven creation of sandboxes via MCP/CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
